data_description.k: Per-gate residual (z-score) a gate must reach to count as hot. Lower is more sensitive, higher cuts more false positives.
data_description.baseline_window_hours: How much history the rolling noise baseline covers. Longer windows adapt more slowly but resist being skewed by one long occupied period.
data_description.enter_score: Combined score needed to flip from vacant to occupied.
data_description.exit_score: Combined score that must be sustained under for the hold timer to run out and flip back to vacant. Kept below the enter score to avoid flapping.
data_description.hold_seconds: How long the score must stay under the exit score, continuously, before occupancy clears.
data_description.freeze_hold_seconds: How long baseline adaptation stays paused after occupancy clears, so a person's lingering thermal/RF signature doesn't get learned into the noise floor.
data_description.support_tau_s: Time constant of the neighbour-elevation smoothing used to rescue a single hot gate next to a mildly elevated neighbour. Larger values smooth over more noise but react more slowly.

data_description.t_dwell_s: Minimum duration, in seconds, of a still-dominant gate episode for it to count as a genuine dwell (in-room evidence).
data_description.t_brief_s: Maximum duration, in seconds, of a gate episode for it to count as a brief sweep (bleed evidence).
data_description.n_bleed_min: Decayed brief-episode count a gate must reach, with no recent sustained episode, before it is classified as bleed.
data_description.n_portal_min: Decayed count of brief episodes that were followed by a dwell before a gate is classified as a doorway (portal).
data_description.portal_lead_frac: Share of a gate's brief episodes that must be followed by a dwell for it to read as a doorway rather than a pass-by.
data_description.lead_window_s: How long, in seconds, after a brief episode a dwell may start and still count as having been led to by it.
data_description.stats_half_life_days: Half-life, in days, of the decayed per-gate episode counts that drive gate classification.
data_description.max_gate: Hard-cap gate classification at OUT beyond this gate index. Leave blank unless a through-wall dwell is being misclassified as in-room.
data_description.ceiling_enabled: Let the learned room boundary suppress gates beyond it. The boundary is always learned and shown on the diagnostic sensor; this only decides whether it acts. Off by default until it has been validated on your own sensors.
data_description.ceil_drop: How far a gate's peak energy must fall below what the sensor's own range falloff predicts for it, before that gate and everything beyond it read as through-wall. Higher values place the boundary closer in.
data_description.n_ceil_min: How many episodes a gate needs before it can take part in the boundary decision, so an unvisited gate never invents a wall.
data_description.ceil_sat: Peak energy at or above which a gate counts as clipped by the sensor's scale, so it is left out of the range-falloff fit the boundary is measured against.
data_description.boundary_confirm_days: How many consecutive daily evaluations must agree on the same boundary before it takes effect.
data_description.energy_floor: Raw move-plus-still energy a candidate must reach somewhere before it may turn occupancy on, which is what rejects the uniformly faint activity a wall attenuates. It never affects an occupancy that is already on. Set to 0 to disable.
data_description.arrival_frac: Share of the strongest movement this sensor has learned to expect that a candidate's moving channel must reach before it may turn occupancy on. Someone walking in reaches it; activity behind a wall is attenuated too far to. It never affects an occupancy that is already on, and does nothing until the sensor has learned a reference. Set to 0 to disable.
data_description.arrival_min_frames: How many frames of a candidate must reach the arrival level, so a single noisy sample cannot admit an entry.
data_description.raw_retention_days: How many days of raw per-frame data are kept before deletion.
data_description.summary_retention_days: How many days of per-minute rollup summaries are kept before deletion.
